pages.title: Eigenvalues
pages.text: $(thing)Eigenvalues$()$(br2)Some directions a matrix only stretches, never turns. How much it stretches them decides whether a system grows, shrinks or circles.

$(thing)Insight$(): 70$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Vectors and Matrices.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Rational Field.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A 2 × 2 matrix has trace T and determinant D. Write the larger of the two amounts L it stretches its own directions by.
